findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_offers, create_checkout, my_bookings · Private data: my_wallet, cancel_booking · Public sink: create_checkout, my_profile, book_intro_call · Destructive: list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_offers, create_checkout, my_bookings · Private data: my_wallet, cancel_booking · Public sink: create_checkout, my_profile, book_intro_call · Destructive: list_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
